sloka: कन्यया त्वेवमुक्तस्तु विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः ।उवाच कैकसीं भूयः पूर्णेन्दुरिव रोहिणीम् ।। ७.९.२५ ॥
transliteration: kanyayā tvevamuktastu viśravā munipuṅgavaḥ ।uvāca kaikasīṁ bhūyaḥ pūrṇenduriva rohiṇīm ।। 7.9.25 ॥

translations.english: But Vishrava, the foremost among sages, thus spoken to by the maiden, spoke again to Kaikasi, just as the full moon speaks to Rohini.
